title: Workspace ONE to Intune — Policy & Compliance Translation
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (translate Workspace ONE profiles/compliance to Intune settings catalog + compliance policy across platforms; parity validation, conditional logic).
hook: Translate every Workspace ONE profile and compliance rule into Intune — with proven parity
problem: The settings are the soul of an MDM migration: every Workspace ONE configuration profile and compliance policy has to be translated into Intune — settings catalog, configuration profiles, and compliance policy — with the same effective posture, or devices quietly become less secure (or break). This solution gives you a repeatable way to translate Workspace ONE policies and compliance into Intune: inventory source policy, map it to Intune across platforms, handle what doesn't translate, and validate parity before cutover.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the policy-translation model, mapping Workspace ONE profiles/compliance to Intune (settings catalog, configuration profiles, compliance policy) per platform, handling unsupported settings, and the parity-validation gate.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, Workspace ONE policy export/inventory, per-platform mapping targets, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory source profiles/compliance, map supported settings to Intune per platform, handle unsupported settings and exceptions, assign to a pilot, validate parity, then expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — source policy/compliance discovery, source-vs-Intune parity validation, a translation coverage and gap report, safe remediation of policy conflicts, and a policy-scope group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable way to translate Workspace ONE policies and compliance into Intune — inventory source policy, map it to the settings catalog/configuration/compliance per platform, handle what doesn't translate, and validate parity before cutover. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A repeatable way to translate Workspace ONE policies and compliance into Intune — inventory source policy, map it to settings catalog/configuration/compliance per platform, handle what doesn't translate, and validate parity before cutover.
